recap.headline: Thug Life Pickups Bury BrookynDynasty Alive
recap.subhead: Quentin Grimes, Keaton Wagler and Rui Hachimura flipped a 3-7 loss into a 6-3 lead, and last night went 9-1-1.

zingers.line: Quentin Grimes, Keaton Wagler and Rui Hachimura together flipped 3-7 into 6-3, and Grimes alone dropped 67 points and 14 threes in two games.
BrookynDynasty went 1-9-1 last night against Thug Life and now trails 4-6 with a 20-15 starts edge as the only comfort.
Nova Knicks lead Zero Fox Given 7-2 because Cam Spencer, Nolan Traore and Mikal Bridges beat the four guys they replaced; without them it is 4-5.
Gopher Gold dropped Saddiq Bey for nobody, and he has put up 49 points and 9 threes for Da Don Da Beard & Da Klaw.
theInfamous cut Klay Thompson and watched him go 56 points and 15 threes for LeParth James, while De'Anthony Melton returned 8 points.
Zero Fox Given sat Kyrie Irving's 17 points and 2 offensive rebounds, and the bench still would have flipped OREB in a 2-7 loss.

night: Toumani Camara powered Thug Life's 9-1-1 rout with 18 points, 4 threes and 3 blocks on 6-of-11 shooting, while KAT added 22 points, 12 boards and 3 blocks.
Keaton Wagler, Thug Life: 7 points on 3-of-10 shooting. The one brick in a 9-1-1 night, and a pickup who still got his team buried in nothing.
No bench blunders showed up last night. Zero Fox Given's Kyrie Irving problem happened earlier in the week and it still stings.
Scoot Henderson put up 27 points and 5 threes on 8-of-12. Jaylen Wells added 22 and Charles Bassey 16 and 13 boards. All three are still on the wire.
Thug Life won the night 9-1-1 against BrookynDynasty, who lost 1-9-1. Nova Knicks went 8-2-1 over Zero Fox Given and LeParth James went 8-1-2 over White Mambas.
